notes.title: SPRINT.FIRE Playtest: What You Should Know
notes.content:
With the SPRINT.FIRE playtest going live, here's some important information to know before jumping in:

[list]
[*] SPRINT.FIRE is still very [b]early[/b] in development. There is virtually no content, there are game-breaking bugs, and match making only works for custom games. Do not expect a polished, ready-to-release title. This is an active development process that'll involved both the community and the developers.

[*] The playtest will be live for several months. If the game is not in a state you're interested in, feel free to check back in a couple months to see how the game has progressed.

[*] There is a community Discord server. We encourage everyone interested in taking part in the playtest at this stage to join. This is where you will be able to talk to the developers live and help bring bugs and improvements to their attention. This invite link can be found here: [url=https://discord.gg/cgyPYraVqg]SPRINT.FIRE Discord Server[/url]
[/list]

With all of this being said, we're very excited to begin playtesting and involving the community in our development.
